test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'POTATO' is coded as 32-30-40-2-40-30 and 'TURNIP' is coded as 40-42-36-28-18-32. How will 'RADISH' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02752a74a5774015bed7162df4a95fffd78ce8dfb9f51a552a399183cdb165bb.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'POTATO' is coded as 32-30-40-2-40-30.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ff78f60bc3ba9f29fcb0d92fdee6b36a8a4cc199023a364636dc8aaa6ab71dd.png] 

and

'TURNIP' is coded as 40-42-36-28-18-32.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d2db625f9c69aa7593c348f9c7f74fb8326dc0486775a91961006d64396539b.png] 

Similarly,

'RADISH' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0c396380bf9d804a1b4c9d8f19d3111393249c8743c508ec08a5d35ae9cee3c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"36-2-8-18-38-16".**
